calculation.formula: IF COUNTD(IF [event_type]="Click" THEN [event_id] END) / IIF(COUNTD(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_id] END) = 0, NULL, COUNTD(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_id] END)) >= 0.03 THEN "Green" ELSEIF COUNTD(IF [event_type]="Click" THEN [event_id] END) / IIF(COUNTD(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_id] END) = 0, NULL, COUNTD(IF [event_type]="Send" THEN [event_id] END)) >= 0.01 THEN "Amber" ELSE "Red" END
